blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – The military has intensified the manhunt against the wanted leader of the group allegedly behind the recent ambushes of soldiers in Basilan. Maj. Gen. Jose Vladimir Cagara, acting commander of the Armed Forces of the Philippines’ Western Mindanao Command (WestMinCom), directed troops to intensify operations against Saddam Siddick, whom he described as a criminal suspect “attempting to make a statement” following the two consecutive attacks against members of the 45th Infantry Battalion. Siddick is wanted for five criminal cases, including murder, even before his group allegedly ambushed troops on Oct. 5 in Tipo-Tipo and on […]...
